pages.text: $(l)Avoid smeltery bottlenecks$()$(li)If items sit waiting in a full Tinkers’ Smeltery, TPS can drop drastically—clear outputs promptly.$(li)Extracting multiple fluids from one tank causes slowdown;
insert and extract from the controller instead.$(li)Don’t automate the Tinkers’ Seared Furnace; use Redstone, Red Matter, or Insanium Furnaces for high-volume smelting.
$(l)Stable multiblock & dimension use$()$(li)Compact Machines can cause crashes and memory leaks.

$(l)Critical troubleshooting steps$()$(li)If the Assembly Table does nothing, check: power (laser), ingredient input, and recipe selection.$(li)If a T3 crafter outputs 0%, verify: encoded recipe, Dragon Heart, output space, and energy.

$(li)NuclearCraft machines don’t need pipes: build them next to each other and they auto-push into the next one. Faulty fluid pipes can even cause odd overheating.$(li)Don’t use Tesseralators or Tesslocator with filters—they crash reliably.
$(li)Ender IO conduit lag often comes from over-filtering and bundles; simplify channels and avoid filtering in output blocks.
